embeds.description:
TrendAI has patched CVE-2026-34926, a medium-severity directory traversal vulnerability in Apex One that has been exploited in the wild. The vulnerability was discovered internally by TrendAI's incident response team. CISA added the CVE to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Thursday, instructing federal agencies to address it by June 4. The article notes that past Apex product exploits have been linked to Chinese state-sponsored hackers, and suggests this vulnerability may also have been exploited by an APT, though no specific attribution is confirmed.
